clue.text: One philandering outside the sultanate is more discreet

indicators.note: outside tells us one piece stands round the other, so the wiser letters enclose the sultanate

parts.note: to be more discreet is to be wiser
Oman is the Gulf sultanate

explanation.surface: A ladies' man abroad in the Gulf learns to keep a lower profile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is more discreet' gives WISER, which goes 'outside' OMAN, the sultanate in Arabia.
explanation.definitionFit: A philanderer is a man who chases women, the very type described by the answer.

clue.text: On the move, like a young man taking Soule's advice

definitions.text: On the move, like a young man taking Soule's advice

parts.words: On the move, like a young man taking Soule's advice
parts.note: John Soule is credited with the advice 'Go West, young man', so a youth who heeds it is travelling towards the sunset

explanation.definitionFit: Heading west is what the famous American advice to young men urged.

clue.text: Sounds like a woman's cereal

indicators.note: sounds like signals the spelling of a word spoken aloud

parts.note: Mae is a woman's name, so Mae's is a woman's

explanation.surface: A breakfast food is said to belong to a lady.
explanation.walkthrough: MAE'S, belonging to a woman named Mae, sounds like the cereal.
explanation.definitionFit: Maize, corn in America, is a cereal crop.

clue.text: He may work late with long breaks

definitions.text: He may work late with long breaks

parts.words: He may work late with long breaks
parts.note: describes someone active in the small hours, the long breaks being night-time hours awake rather than rests

explanation.definitionFit: A person who stays up and works late at night is named after a nocturnal bird.

clue.text: Female boss holding record area of grazing land?

indicators.note: holding means the two outer words close round the record

parts.note: she is the female pronoun
to boss something is to run it
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A woman in charge keeps a disc in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss' as a verb means to manage or direct; the question mark warns that the definition is a cryptic description of pasture.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheep-run is a tract of pasture where flocks are kept to graze.

clue.text: Comment from soldier married on ship

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, stands for soldiers
the ark was Noah's ship

explanation.surface: A newly-wed soldier makes an observation aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: RE (Royal Engineers) and M (married) come 'on' ARK in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A remark is a spoken observation or comment.

clue.text: Wounded pride cuts the game short

indicators.note: cut short means the game's name loses its final letter

parts.note: piquet is a card game for two

explanation.surface: Someone sulks after a card game is ended early.
explanation.walkthrough: PIQUET is an old two-handed card game; 'short' removes its last letter T.
explanation.definitionFit: Pique is resentment born of injured self-esteem, a fit of hurt vanity.

clue.text: Diver endlessly breathing in quick short breaths

indicators.note: endlessly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: puffing is breathing in short gasps

explanation.surface: A swimmer surfaces, gasping and panting.
explanation.walkthrough: PUFFING 'endlessly' loses its G.
explanation.definitionFit: The puffin is a seabird that dives for fish.

clue.text: Quite bold when developing a scholastic argument

indicators.note: developing suggests something changing form, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rather daring point emerges in a learned debate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developing' rearranges the letters of QUITE BOLD.
explanation.definitionFit: A quodlibet was a question posed for debate in medieval scholastic disputation.

clue.text: Thin and emaciated Oriental first seen in wood

indicators.note: first means the Oriental letter comes before the other piece

parts.note: E stands for East, Oriental
bony means skinny and gaunt

explanation.surface: A gaunt Eastern figure is spotted among the trees.
explanation.walkthrough: E (East) comes 'first', ahead of BONY.
explanation.definitionFit: Ebony is a hard black timber from tropical trees.

clue.text: Cut short detailed complaint

indicators.note: de-tailed, with its tail removed, so the illness loses its last letter

parts.note: shingles is a painful viral illness, a complaint

explanation.surface: Someone brusquely interrupts a long, itemised grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' is read as de-tailed: SHINGLES loses its final S. To shingle hair is to crop it close.
explanation.definitionFit: To shingle hair is an old term for cropping it close, a hairdresser's verb for a short bob.

clue.text: Family criminal rehabilitated thus if received by Chinese leader

indicators.note: received by means the reworked letters are taken inside the leader's name

parts.note: Mao Zedong led communist China

indicators.note: rehabilitated suggests something rebuilt, so the letters of the two short words are rearranged

parts.note: so means thus

explanation.surface: A mob member goes straight after being taken in by Chairman Mao.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rehabilitated' turns SO (thus) plus IF into FIOS, which is 'received by' MAO to give MA-FIOS-O.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Mafia, whose crime groups are called families, is a gangster of that organisation.

clue.text: Student gripped by strong rhythm heard in 4

indicators.note: gripped by means the student letter is held inside the rhythm word

parts.note: a beat is a strong rhythm
L, the learner plate, stands for a student

explanation.surface: A pupil is held by a powerful beat audible somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition cross-refers to 4 down, SHEEP-RUN: the sound heard there is a sheep's cry. L (learner) sits inside BEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A bleat is the cry of sheep, so it is the noise you would hear on grazing land for them.

clue.text: First division supporter? Not altogether

parts.note: a part is a division of something
I is the Roman numeral one, first
an ally is a supporter

explanation.surface: A fan of a top-flight football team is only half-hearted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First division' suggests football's top league, but the I is the Roman numeral, like the heading of a book's first section.
explanation.definitionFit: Partially means to some extent only, incompletely rather than wholly.

clue.text: A French politician fearful of being banned

parts.note: un is the French for a
L stands for Liberal, a politician
awful can mean fearful or full of dread

explanation.surface: A timid French politician worries about being barred from office.
explanation.definitionFit: Something banned is prohibited by law, i.e. illegal.

clue.text: Expressing praise for archbishop — an opponent of the Whigs

parts.note: William Laud was Archbishop of Canterbury under Charles I
the Tories were the rival party to the Whigs

explanation.surface: Someone extols an archbishop who opposed the Whig party.
explanation.walkthrough: LAUD, a 17th-century Archbishop of Canterbury, plus A plus TORY.
explanation.definitionFit: Laudatory means full of commendation, eulogistic.

clue.text: A bird provides part of his alibi, strangely enough

annotationWithheld.why: A bird provides part of his alibi, strangely enough (4): no run of 'his alibi' holds the letters I, B, I, S, so no hidden-word or anagram parse gives the answer as printed
annotationWithheld.clue: A bird provides part of his alibi, strangely enough

clue.text: Career cricketer keeping old vessel

parts.note: to career is to rush, and speed is rapid motion

indicators.note: keeping means the cricketer holds the old letter within

parts.note: a bat is a batsman in cricket

explanation.surface: A professional cricketer hangs on to an old boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Career' is not a job here but rushing: SPEED. A bat is a batsman in cricket; BAT 'keeping' O makes BOAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A speedboat is a fast motor-driven boat, a small vessel.

clue.text: Fruit put English member in great discomfort

indicators.note: in means the two pieces go inside the discomfort word

parts.note: pain is great discomfort
an arm is a limb, a member

explanation.surface: Some fruit caused an Englishman's limb terrible pain.
explanation.walkthrough: E and ARM go 'in' PAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A pearmain is a variety of apple.

clue.text: Star with house in Florence — a noted 1 ac

parts.note: casa is Italian for house, and Florence is in Italy
a nova is a star that suddenly brightens

explanation.surface: A celebrity owns a villa in Tuscany.
explanation.walkthrough: '1 ac' refers to 1 across, the philanderer; the Venetian adventurer is the famous example.
explanation.definitionFit: Giacomo Casanova, the Venetian adventurer, is the byword for a serial seducer.

clue.text: The same old city, and so grim!

parts.note: do, short for ditto, means the same
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city

explanation.surface: Someone finds the ancient city just as bleak as before.
explanation.walkthrough: DO is the abbreviation of ditto; UR is the biblical city of Abraham.
explanation.definitionFit: Dour describes a stern, gloomy, unsmiling manner.

clue.text: Sally appears to go without one meal, say

indicators.note: without means the numeral for one is dropped from the verb

parts.note: to repair to a place is to go there
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: say signals a word spoken, so the meal's name gives a sound-alike spelling

parts.note: tea is a light afternoon or evening meal

explanation.surface: Someone seems ready to skip a meal, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: REPAIR (go) 'without' I gives REPAR; then 'say' turns TEA into its sound-alike TEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a witty retort, and quick witty exchanges are this kind of banter.

clue.text: Superficial notes kept in folder

indicators.note: kept in means the notes are put inside the folder word

parts.note: a file is a folder for papers
A and C are musical notes

explanation.surface: Shallow remarks are stored in a ring binder.
explanation.walkthrough: A and C, two musical notes, are 'kept in' FILE.
explanation.definitionFit: Facile means glib or shallow, lacking depth.

clue.text: Move unhurriedly when revolution is under way

indicators.note: in a down clue, being under puts the revolution word below the way

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
a roll is a turning over, a revolution

explanation.surface: Someone ambles along while a rebellion is in progress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolution' suggests uprising but is a ROLL, which 'is under' ST in this down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To stroll is to walk at a leisurely pace.

clue.text: A letter revealing moral strength

definitions.meaning: any letter of the alphabet is a written symbol of this kind
integrity of personality, as in a person of real backbone

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a written symbol such as a letter and firmness of moral nature.

clue.text: He manages to make a profit from the Arabs, possibly

definitions.meaning: someone who manages is one who copes

definitions.text: to make a profit from the Arabs, possibly
definitions.meaning: a horse-dealer trades in horses, perhaps Arab horses, for gain

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both one who copes and, in old usage, a horse-dealer.

clue.text: Helped to produce poster featuring fish

indicators.note: featuring means the poster word holds the fish within it

parts.note: an ad is a poster or advertisement
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Someone assisted in making a fish advertisement.
explanation.walkthrough: The ide, also called the orfe, is a European freshwater fish common in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Aided means assisted, gave help to.

clue.text: Part of the constituency upset over politician's way of speaking

indicators.note: over in a down clue places the first piece above the politician
upset in a down clue turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: a ward is an electoral division of a constituency
L stands for Liberal, a politician

explanation.surface: Part of a seat turns against a politician's speaking manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' in a down clue turns the electoral division upside down; 'over' sets it above the Liberal.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawl is a slow, lengthened manner of speech.

clue.text: Reservation in book is October 1

parts.note: Prov is the abbreviation for Proverbs, a book of the Bible
taken as written

indicators.note: the figure one asks for the opening letter of the month's name

explanation.surface: A booking in a diary appears to fall on the first of October.
explanation.walkthrough: PROV (Proverbs) plus IS plus the first letter of October, signalled by '1'.
explanation.definitionFit: A proviso is a condition or qualification attached to an agreement, a reservation.

clue.text: Fruit causing cockney confusion and trouble

indicators.note: a cockney speaker drops the aitch at the front of words

parts.note: havoc means chaos or confusion
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: Some fruit causes chaos and bother in the East End.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, are said to drop their aitches, so 'cockney' removes the opening H.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocado is a pear-shaped tropical fruit.

clue.text: Poem or song mostly introduced during Scripture

indicators.note: introduced during means the shortened song goes inside the Scripture letters

parts.note: RE, religious education, was the school Scripture lesson

indicators.note: mostly means the song word loses its last letter

parts.note: a hymn is a religious song

explanation.surface: A verse or a song is brought into a Bible class.
explanation.walkthrough: HYMN 'mostly' is HYM, 'introduced during' RE (religious education).
explanation.definitionFit: A rhyme is a short verse, a piece of poetry.

clue.text: Carriage seen in estate leased by a university

parts.note: land is an estate
let means leased

explanation.surface: A carriage is found on property rented out by a college.
explanation.definitionFit: A landaulet is a small horse-drawn coach with a folding top over the rear seats.
